cohort: 268 women with fertility requirements following myomectomy
finding: Laparoscopic myomectomy is a feasible treatment for women with fertility desires who have leiomyomas, with comparable pregnancy outcomes to transabdominal myomectomy but a higher risk of uterine scar defects.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate due to myomectomy history was higher after transabdominal myomectomy than laparoscopic myomectomy.
